masterPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a single front-facing full-body master illustration candidate for preparing a Live2D model of the existing Karolina character.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved turnaround, the MAIN identity/outfit/proportion/left-right placement reference. Image 2 is the authoritative special eye design. Image 3 is the authoritative hairstyle reference. Image 4 specifies the open cape-jacket construction. Image 5 specifies the plain single white mid-calf sock. These are references, not collage elements.
Primary request: render ONLY ONE Karolina, facing the camera straight on, head upright, shoulders and hips facing front, looking straight ahead with calm restrained neutral expression and closed mouth. Full body visible from bow to boot soles. Comfortable neutral standing pose, arms slightly separated from torso, hands relaxed with five anatomically correct fingers each. Feet comfortably separated and forward facing. Preserve the character's identity, proportions and outfit; do not redesign her. Use the main front figure's left/right layout exactly.
Style: match the approved polished anime illustration, fine controlled linework, detailed clean cel/painterly shading and beautiful rich purple color. Even diffuse illumination suitable for separating layers later; no strong directional cast shadows.
Identity: plum-dark hair transitioning to luminous lilac/purple tips, low side ponytail on viewer RIGHT with small lilac butterfly tie; oversized angular black-and-lilac bow on viewer LEFT. Keep layered bangs but leave both eyes sufficiently visible. Violet iridescent gemstone-like irises with the distinctive narrow vertical double-pointed geometric butterfly/K-like pupils exactly inspired by Image 2, not ordinary round pupils. Soft pale skin, understated mature calm expression, matching face.
Clothing: open cropped dark cape jacket with lapels, straps, grommets, purple triangular network lines and small abstract circle/button/controller and agent-node glyphs; white high-collar inner top with its asymmetric triangular mesh inset and translucent white puff sleeves; dark belt, dark asymmetric layered skirt with lilac translucent geometric overskirt and angular draped tails. Outfit remains modest and fully dressed. Preserve these recognizable layers.
Accessories: one modern smartphone clipped at viewer-RIGHT waist, facing front enough that its screen is visible, screen showing ONLY two simple circular eyes and a tiny geometric mouth with optional short-line eyebrows. No text or name on phone. Viewer-LEFT leg wears dark opaque thigh-high sock. Viewer-RIGHT leg wears ONE plain white mid-calf sock, with exposed knee and thigh. A separate narrow technical band is on the bare upper thigh of the white-sock leg, with ample skin between band and sock. Matching low-profile dark mechanical ankle boots with purple details, preserve reference silhouette and restrained sole thickness.
Composition: portrait canvas, largest practical high resolution, character occupies about 90% of height with clear transparent margin on every side. Keep ALL hair, ribbon, hands, skirt tails and shoes in frame. Actual transparent background and clean alpha edges. Garment translucency is intentional and distinct from backdrop transparency. No floor, no contact shadow, no scenic background, no glow halo, no fake checkerboard texture, no labels, no callouts, no multiple poses, no reference sheet panels, no watermark.
Deliver only the one assembled character illustration. This is a master art candidate, not a claim that the image is already a layered PSD or rigged Live2D model.
alphaCorrectionPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Karolina master illustration. Preserve the EXACT character, face, special violet geometric pupils, dark-to-lilac side ponytail, large angular bow, pose, costume patterns, skirt shape, smartphone and simple geometric screen face, socks, thigh band, boots, proportions, rendering and all colors. DO NOT redraw, restyle, simplify or redesign the character. Change ONLY background and alpha matting.
Deliver a clean standalone full-body cutout with a truly transparent empty background. Remove all purple/pink background haze and glow outside the character silhouette. ALL SKIN (face, ears, neck, hands, bare thigh, knee, lower leg above the white sock) MUST BE FULLY OPAQUE. All hair core, opaque cloth, white inner top and white sleeve cores, white sock, dark sock, boots, phone and hardware MUST BE OPAQUE; only the actual sheer outer garment mesh and antialiased silhouette edges may have intentional partial alpha. Skin is solid skin, NEVER translucent. Preserve faint hair strands and ribbons with clean edges. No backdrop, no cast shadow, no floor, no halo, no checkerboard texture. Keep whole character and boots within canvas. This is a corrected master art candidate, NOT a layered PSD or rig.
